svg.title: BC Fish & Game Branch — historical blazer embroidery
svg.desc: Clean vector reconstruction from visible artifact references; no photograph tracing, source textures or embedded raster. Natural outlined replacement fonts approximate embroidered alphabets. Exact stitch anatomy, manufacturing dimensions and calibrated thread colors remain unverified. Whole-master source placement uses uniform scale; the photograph is not used to distort separate border or emblem components. The native Plateforge1917-late Type3 historical achievement is reused without a modern helmeted achievement. This is historical artwork reconstruction, not a verified production engraving. Fine red/green embroidered accents in the reference are simplified to gold achievement linework and a green branch ribbon; their tiny exact painted distribution is not recovered. The rectangular navy field is a presentation of the photographed blazer cloth; a separate rectangular patch cut is not asserted.
